profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: IT Professional | Perpetual Learner | Productivity Guru | Fisticuffs Connoisseur

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed full-stack applications by integrating Claude code with Figma and Jira, enhancing project collaboration.  
• Improved API functionality through enhancements using Node.js and TypeScript, ensuring robust performance.  
• Adhered to unit testing protocols, maintaining high code coverage and quality standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Claude Skills · TypeScript · React.js · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed RESTful APIs and backend services using C# and ASP.NET in an MVC Web Application.  
• Built and maintained an Enterprise Service Bus with RabbitMQ and MassTransit for efficient distributed system communication.  
• Implemented OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect for secure authentication across multiple applications.  
• Developed WPF desktop applications using MVVM to enhance internal administrative operations.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · ASP.NET Web API · Microsoft SQL Server · Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) Architecture

positions.title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
positions.description:
• Led and mentored development teams to deliver software solutions for Accounting, Trading, Pricing, and Tax departments.  
• Developed contingency and valuation applications to accurately calculate Net Asset Values.  
• Automated pricing feeds from major vendors including Vanguard, Bloomberg, and JPMorgan to enhance efficiency.  
• Analyzed system defects and guided implementations to improve overall system stability.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Business Analysis · Team Leadership · .NET Framework · SQL

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Developed Java-based automation tools to identify locomotive parts nearing warranty expiration, significantly reducing warranty costs.  
• Analyzed malfunctioning part trends and generated manufacturer claims to enhance operational efficiency.  
• Created reporting macros that streamlined processes, saving approximately 10 hours of manual reporting each week.  
• Assisted with accounting and financial reporting for over 100 locomotive claims, contributing to improved financial oversight.
positions.insights: Skills: VBA · Java · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Access · Python (Programming Language)
